request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows the signed-in user's own due-total and overdue-total. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

The whole change is in `src/main/frontend/features/header/header.slot.tsx`. Nothing changed on the server or in the stored data, because the figures are built from data the screen already loads.

- **Finding the person:** it looks for someone on the sheet whose name matches the user's name, ignoring case, which is how the app already compares names. If no name matches, it checks aliases the same way. A name match is used before an alias match.
- **The figures:** it uses the same calculations as that person's row (`person-due-total` and `person-overdue-total`), so the header always shows the same numbers as the row.
- **No match:** both `my-due-total` and `my-overdue-total` are empty.
- **Display:** they appear in the header after the sheet totals, labelled "My due total" and "My overdue total".

If the person's due is not available, the header shows "n/a", the same as their row does. None of the tests checks that case.
